0022600123.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (0-3, 13th in the East, 5th in the Central) host the Indiana Pacers (2-1, 5th in the East, 2nd in the Central), with Milwaukee looking to snap a three-game losing streak and Indiana riding a one-game winning streak. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, while the Bucks won the 2025-26 series 4-0, most recently beating Indiana 134-123 in Milwaukee on March 15, 2026. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), all out, while Aaron Nesmith (hamstring) and Andrew Nembhard (neck soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions.
